## About
Castle Hills Auto Service and Repair is a full service auto shop in Lewisville. We handle everyday maintenance like oil changes, tires and A/C tune ups, along with larger repairs, for vehicles of all makes and models.
We're part of North Texas Auto Services, and our sister shop, Stonebriar Auto Service, is over in Frisco.
Neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating across 617 Google reviews. One reviewer said Kevin, a manager, took the time to explain the repair and the parts needed.

## Services
- Oil change: Stop in for an oil change. One reviewer came by without an appointment and was back on the road quickly.
- Tires and wheels: Tire and wheel service for your car or truck.
- A/C tune up: Keep the air conditioning working through a North Texas summer.
- Routine maintenance and repairs: Regular upkeep or fixing something bigger.
- Audi service and repair: Maintenance and repairs for Audi models.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my make of car?
A: We offer auto repair for vehicles of all makes and models. Give us a call and we'll talk it through.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. Saturday hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Do you offer pick up and drop off?
A: We offer courtesy pick up and drop off service to local customers. Call to check if you're in the area.

Q: Is there somewhere to wait?
A: Yes. One reviewer said the waiting area was comfortable and has a kids' section for families.
